lines.tts: Ram fought fourteen thousand demons. Alone.
Welcome to part five of the Ramayan series.

caps: In *PANCHAVATI,* | a demoness named *SURPANAKHA* | saw Ram,
lines.tts: In Panchavati, a demoness named Shoorpanakha saw Ram, and wanted him for herself.

caps: Ram said: | I am married. | Try my brother.
lines.tts: Ram said: I am married. Try my brother. Lakshman sent her right back.

caps: and Lakshman cut off | her *NOSE AND EARS.*
lines.tts: Furious, she lunged at Sita, and Lakshman cut off her nose and ears.

caps: She ran screaming to her brother *KHARA.* | He sent 14 demons. | Ram's arrows *FINISHED THEM.*
lines.tts: She ran screaming to her brother Khara. He sent fourteen demons. Ram's arrows finished them.
Then Khara came himself, with fourteen thousand.

caps: Ram sent Sita and Lakshman | into a cave, | and faced them *ALONE.*
lines.tts: Ram sent Sita and Lakshman into a cave, and faced them alone.

caps: His arrows fell *LIKE RAIN.* | *DUSHANA* fell. *TRISHIRA* fell. | And at last, *KHARA.*
lines.tts: His arrows fell like rain. Dooshana fell. Trishira fell. And at last, Khara.

caps: Valmiki says it took | one and a half *MUHURTAS:*
lines.tts: Valmiki says it took one and a half muhurtas: about seventy two minutes.

caps: Sita ran out of the cave | and *HUGGED HIM.*
lines.tts: Sita ran out of the cave, and hugged him.

caps: But one demon | *ESCAPED,* | and ran to *RAVANA.*
lines.tts: But one demon escaped, and ran to Ravana.

caps: *NEXT, PART 6:* | Ravana's plan, | and a *GOLDEN DEER.*
lines.tts: Next, part six. Ravana's plan, and a golden deer.
Follow, so you don't miss it, and comment, Jai Shri Ram!
